_about: staging/notes before the round-3 re-rolls (2026-10-19); null = no note

old.413_tuoktis: A couple exchanging rings before a registry official at a desk, the groom sliding a ring onto the bride's finger, both looking at the ring, the official facing the viewer. Insets: the two hands with rings close-up; the couple signing the register with plain strokes; guests throwing grain.
old.A2-0660: Main picture: a zebra crossing seen at an angle — bold white stripes across the asphalt, a mother and child and a man crossing on them, a Zhiguli stopped at the line, a crossing sign post. The striped crossing with people on it is the subject. Insets: the pedestrian signal light; a hand on a child's hand at the kerb; the stripes from above.
old.A2-1416: Main picture: a male folk dancer in a sash and boots caught mid-leap, both feet off the floor, arms wide, his partner spinning with her skirt flaring, an accordion at the side. The leaping dancer is the subject. Insets: dancing feet; a ballet dancer en pointe; a couple in a dance hold.
old.A2-1431: Main picture: a man in a clothes shop with one arm into a new jacket, turning to the mirror, the assistant holding a second jacket on a hanger, a tape measure around her neck. The garment being tried for size is the subject. Insets: a foot pushed into a new shoe with a shoehorn; a hat tried before a mirror; a tape measure around a waist.
